title: Rafael and the Weather
author: Rosalind Ishikawa
blurb: Mara Oyelaran, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
